stanza: Somewhere between drunkenness and charity
She puts her hand on the sleeve of my coat
She says, "I've missed this"
I say, "I know, I've missed you, too"
She says, "I was actually talking about your coat"
She makes me laugh, oh, how she makes me laugh
I just let my head sink down and fake some deep sobs

charity.line: Mama and Betsy say, "Find yourself a charity
stanza: Dora says, "Have children"
Mama and Betsy say, "Find yourself a charity
Help the needy and the crippled
Or put some time into ecology"
Well, there's a wide wide world of noble causes
And lovely landscapes to discover
But all I really wanna do right now
Is find another lover
"And You know I ain't never prayed before
But it always seemed to me
If praying is the same as begging, Lord
I don't take no charity"

charity.line: Give your heart and soul to charity
stanza: When I first saw you
The end was soon
To Bethlehem, it slouched
And then, must've caught a good look at you
Give your heart and soul to charity
'Cause the rest of you
The best of you
Honey, belongs to me
